commits.message:
refactor(daemon): the hook's session_id is the checked SessionId, so a request carries its session once (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.6ql)

From the high review of #720:
- the request and payload inputs drop their second session field; hookData.session_id is typed SessionId at the checkpoint
- Subscriptions.sources is a Map keyed by session, so no session is listed twice
- the doctor's sighting parsers brand a session id only through the checkpoint
- the transcript folds, effect sessions, lane-setup queue and pane lookup key by SessionId
- tests build session ids by the checkpoint, with no casts
test: session ids in tests are built by the checkpoint, and a stored key it refuses is reported and not loaded (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.6ql)
refactor(daemon): the checked SessionId travels from its door to every unit that keys by it (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.6ql)
test(daemon-log): the dispose-mid-flush case counts only the log file's own opens (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.jg5)

refactor(daemon): the idle clock keys sessions by the checked SessionId (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.snf) (#718)

* refactor(daemon): the idle clock keys sessions by the checked SessionId, so its menu-idle turn names its session with no cast (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.snf)

The clock's records, pending counts, methods and deps take SessionId; the
verb context's clickLanded, closeIdleMenus and the renderer's closeIdle
pass it through. Every caller already held a checked id, so nothing parses
anew, and closeByTurn's cast and its parse-dont-validate exception go. The
verb layer's wider sid: string stays: it reads ids, and SessionId narrows
to string there.

* test(click-order): both fixture sessions are checked SessionIds (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.snf)

* refactor(verbs): journaled takes the checked SessionId its callers already pass (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.snf)
